item.title: OASIS Plays Historic First Show in 16 Years as NOEL GALLAGHER Dedicates Song to Young Fans: 'You Kept Us Hot for 20 Years'
item.description: Oasis is officially back. The British rock band returned to the stage this weekend for the first time in 16 years, kicking off their long-awaited reunion tour in front of a packed crowd at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, Wales.

item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Honored With New 'Working Class Hero' Display in Hometown
item.description: A new exhibition honoring Ozzy Osbourne is now open in his hometown of Birmingham, England. The “Working Class Hero” exhibit launched Wednesday (June 25) at the Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.
